title: Malformed Hip and Pain
excerpt: My visit turned out to be extraordinary, after all the years of failing I could not believe what was happening.
content:
My visit turned out to be extraordinary, after all the years of failing I could not believe what was happening. Even the natural methods I had used before attending the program had little to no effect. What I liked the most was the wheatgrass therapy.   After just 3 days the my left hip, which had been there for 62 years, began to decreased.    During a consultation with Brian he advised me to use magnets by placing them on the most painful areas of my body. He also strongly advised that I get into the pool and exercise three different ways. One suggestion was using weights on my legs as I freely moved in the water. Initially this was difficult since Francine, my friend would not come into the pool so one of the loving staff members, Joyce Ann, came to help us. Within one month my pain in my leg was gone. It took a total 1 ½ months to rid myself of all the pain in my leg, back, hip and neck. I am enjoying the living cuisine, consuming three green drinks a day, and following the program to a T. I swim like a fish three times a week, walk every morning for ¾ of an hour, and do stretching exercises every day at home. I am so grateful and I know I will never again be in a wheelchair. My stay at Hippocrates changed my life forever and all that I learned I will constantly cherish and employ. Now I can play with my grandchildren, ride a bike, and have a wonderful life. The Institute is a very important place that saved my life. I hope others make their way to this oasis to heal themselves and become examples of what God intended for us all, a pain free, healthy life!.

Vol 24 Issue 1 page 4
